note: Owner's standing gate decisions for daily Blanc Betas (owner, 2026-11-14: they carry until the owner changes them). A waiver applies to betas from 'since' up to, not including, 'until'; retire one by setting 'until', never by deleting it, so earlier releases still verify. A carried gate counts only while no file matching 'paths' or 'anyChange' changed since its lastPass.sourceCommit. Beside its own paths, every carried check comes due when the Chromium version changes: the 'version' and 'upstream' fields of chromium/lanes/desktop.json, compared between the check's last pass and the release (owner, 2026-11-15: only passkey code or Chromium makes the passkey check due; owner, 2026-11-17: "Yes, narrow it": the files under chromium/upstream/ that are pinned for a new patch no longer count, only the version). anyChange, a list of paths that make every check due, is empty. Evidence paths are on the Mac Studio; their digests are pinned here. Edit only on the owner's word, quoting it in the commit. docs/chromium-beta-release.md, 'Daily betas'. A limitation in 'keptLimits' stays in the release notes and on the website after its waiver is retired: the gate passes, and the thing is still not in the beta.
archWaiver: Owner standing decision 2026-11-14: daily betas are Apple Silicon only; Intel is deferred until a separately qualified native build.
whatToKnow: - **A separate app.** Blanc Beta has its own name, its own data folder and its own passkeys. Your regular Blanc, its data, settings and passkeys are left untouched.
- **Apple Silicon Macs, macOS 13 or later.** There is no Intel build of this beta.
- **Blocking is built in.** Ads and trackers are blocked from the first page, including in private windows.
- **Its own updates.** Beta updates come from blanc.day, signed with the beta's own key. They never touch the regular Blanc.
- **Touch ID passkeys** work, in ordinary and private windows.

notes.no-drm-handoff: - **Protected video** (such as Netflix or Spotify) doesn't play. Blanc Beta shows a notice offering to open the site in the regular Blanc.
notes.production-sync-real-device: - **Sync** is included but still being checked against the live service, so don't rely on it yet.

no-drm-handoff.reason: Owner standing waiver 2026-11-14: daily betas ship without the protected-video notice and its Electron Blanc handoff (D3/X2) until that notice is built; on a site that asks for protected video, playback fails. Make no public claim about protected video in Blanc Beta.
no-drm-handoff.retired: Owner, 2026-11-17 ("Yes, retire it"): the protected-video notice with Open in released Blanc is built (patch 0091), so from beta.7 the gate must pass on its own check.

production-sync-real-device.reason: Owner standing waiver 2026-11-14: daily betas ship without the real-iPhone Sync pass on each notarized build; desktop Sync is checked on the prototype, and the release notes keep the caution that Sync is not checked end to end.

webauthn.check: Touch ID passkeys on the notarized build (remote/beta4-5-owner-checks.command's passkey questions)

sparkle-N-to-N+1.check: the local update proof (local-update-proof.mjs), then the signed handoff from the previous public beta on a copy

desktop-sync.check: native-sync-organic-tabs.mjs on the prototype and beta-sync.mjs on a local-qualification build

no-drm-handoff.check: native-protected-media.mjs on the prototype (the notice, Not now, Open in released Blanc, Get released Blanc)
